scientific_limitations: Finite binary five-word equality census only. Minimum cardinality 12 and one optimized path length 6 already reported in 2024; newly established are all ten equality cases, complement classes and their complete path and fair-bit first-hit spectra. Supplementary materials were not accessible; unindexed previous calculation remains a possible originality risk. No independent validation.
title: Complete equality classification of strand-symmetric binary five-mer decycling sets
